success_rule_evaluation.rule: For the primary policy (joint_leontief) in BOTH co-primary cells separately, using queue-order completion: (1) mean completion higher than DRF; (2) paired 95% bootstrap interval for Leontief minus DRF strictly above zero; (3) point estimate at least 1.0 additional completed task per 48-task run; (4) no increase in the observed zero-completion fraction relative to DRF; (5) capacity, bound, fallback, and infeasibility counts all zero. A pooled interval cannot substitute for failure in one co-primary cell. Locally-optimized completion is a required robustness result that controls interpretation but is not part of the formal success rule.
